name: alibaba/wan/2.6/flash/reference-to-video
description: Alibaba Wan 2.6 Flash reference-to-video model that places characters from reference images or videos into a new scene, with optional generated audio and multi-shot control.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

images.title: Images
images.description: Reference images for subject consistency (0-5 images). Combined with video_urls, total references cannot exceed 5. Formats: JPEG, JPG, PNG (no alpha), BMP, WEBP. Resolution: 240-5000px. Max 10MB each. Reference order: image_urls continue numbering after video_urls.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: Dance battle between Character1 and Character2.
prompt.description: Use Character1, Character2, etc. to reference subjects from your reference files. Works for people, animals, or objects. For multi-shot prompts: '[0-3s] Shot 1. [3-6s] Shot 2.' Max 1500 characters. Reference order: video_urls first, then image_urls.

items.limit_description: Max file size: 100.0MB, Min duration: 2s, Max duration: 30s, Timeout: 30.0s

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Reference videos for subject consistency (0-3 videos). Videos' FPS must be at least 16 FPS. Combined with image_urls, total references cannot exceed 5. Reference order: video_urls are numbered first (Character1, Character2...), then image_urls continue the sequence.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds. R2V Flash supports only 5 or 10 seconds.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Video resolution tier. R2V Flash only supports 720p and 1080p.

multi_shots.title: Multi Shots
multi_shots.description: When true (default), enables intelligent multi-shot segmentation for coherent narrative videos with multiple shots. When false, generates single continuous shot. Only active when enable_prompt_expansion is True.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image.

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Whether to generate a video with audio. Set to false for silent video generation. Silent videos are faster and cost half of the audio version price.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

input.prompt: Dance battle between Character1 and Character2.

readme:
# Wan 2.6 Flash Reference to Video

The fast, lower-cost Wan 2.6 reference tier. Cast characters from reference images or videos into a new scene for quick iterations; audio generation and multi-shot cuts are on by default.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Text instruction. |
| `images` | image URL[] | — | Reference images, Image 1, Image 2, … |
| `videos` | video URL[] | — | Reference clips, Video 1, Video 2, … |
| `resolution` | `720p` / `1080p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `duration` | 5 / 10 | 5 | Output length in seconds. |
| `multi_shots` | boolean | true | Let the model cut between several shots. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `16:9` / `9:16` / `1:1` / `4:3` / `3:4` | `16:9` | Output frame shape. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |
| `generate_audio` | boolean | true | Generate a synchronized audio track; turning it off halves the rate. |

## Billing

With audio you pay $0.10 per output second at 720p and $0.15 at 1080p; silent output costs half. When you send reference `videos`, 5 seconds of input are added to the billed length.

| Output | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|
| 5s with audio | $0.50 | $0.75 |
| 5s silent | $0.25 | $0.375 |
| 5s with audio + reference video | $1.00 | $1.50 |
| 10s with audio | $1.00 | $1.50 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Refer to references by number and give each a role.
- Keep the action simple for fast drafts, then rerun the winner on the non-Flash tier.

## Limits

- Durations are 5 or 10 seconds.

## Also on SandBase

Other Wan 2.6 endpoints: `alibaba/wan/2.6/text-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/image-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/reference-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/flash/image-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/text-to-image`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/image-to-image`, `alibaba/wan/2.7/text-to-video` (newer).
